title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Lockdown
Inside Corcoran, survival is the number one priority for inmates and officers alike, whether it's inmates treading the dangerous waters of racial politics; or officers keeping themselves and the population safe by tracking down cell-made weapons.

title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Prison Politics
Violence often seems inevitable in prison; whether it stems from racial tension, or a dispute between cellmates, it's the job of Corcoran's officers to prevent attacks; in doing so, however, they put their own lives on the line.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Taking a Hostage
At the Penitentiary of New Mexico, officers are outnumbered, and the inmates are unpredictable, especially in Level 6, the maximum-security facility; it's where the deputy warden says "the worst of the worst" are housed.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S3 E5 — It's Complicated
If personal relationships can get complicated on the outside, they can be even more complicated behind bars; for those unable to cope with them, relationships can lead to a life in prison.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S3 E4 — The Three R's
Sometimes life has other plans, like when the ex-leader of a white supremacist gang faces a whole new reality, and discovers the price for coming clean.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S4 E2 — LOL...JK
In prison WTF stands for workouts, tattoos and food.

description:
S3 E2 — Harsh Reality
Sometimes life has other plans, like when the ex leader of a gang faces a whole new reality he discovers the price for coming clean.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E5 — The Killer Next Door
Behind every murder is a motive; Behind every murder is a story and behind some murders, there is a person someone thought they could trust.

title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — You Wanna Work Where?
Burnout is a constant problem and unexcused absences create staff shortages at Alabama's Holman Correctional Facility; that means that designated jobs, like cell searches, which each shift has a requirement to perform, don't always get done.
